name: as-usual
description: An agent harness that keeps one recorded work folder per piece of work — its decisions, request boundary, plan, investigation evidence, and verification — in files, so a later session can resume from disk.

interface.shortDescription: Keep one recorded work folder per piece of work, with its decisions and evidence in files.
interface.longDescription: AsUsual adds a session-start hook and artifact templates. Work that the harness picks up gets one work folder; only its request boundary — investigation only, plan only, or execute — is recorded up front, and what the folder produces follows from the request. Each record keeps contexts.md and an append-only audit.jsonl, so decisions, approvals, and verification evidence survive the session.
defaultPrompt: Use AsUsual for this — classify it and start the work unit.
